slides.title: Three problems hold the harbour back
bullets: No shelter for visitors arriving by sea
Fishing and leisure boats sharing one basin

illustration.subject: a cracked stone quay wall lapped by waves

slides.notes: Each problem has a cost we measured last year.

slides.title: What residents asked for
bullets: A promenade along the north quay that stays open all year round, with benches and lighting
A covered market hall for the morning fish auction and the weekend producers
Separate moorings for fishing boats and for leisure sailing, with a clear channel
Safe walking routes between the old town and the waterfront, day and night
A small museum telling the story of the harbour and its families
Public toilets and drinking water near the ferry landing
Bicycle parking and a shuttle stop at the harbour entrance
Trees and shade on the south quay for the summer months
A calendar of events shared by every association on the waterfront
